exposure: planned place of birth (Midwife-led unit (MLU) or Obstetric unit (OU))
outcome: intrapartum transfer rates from MLU to OU
postpartum transfer rates from MLU to OU
cohort: A total of 878 low-risk women with uncomplicated pregnancies who gave birth in either a Midwife-led unit or an Obstetric unit of the same Spanish hospital between January 2018 and December 2020.
finding: Women giving birth in a Midwife-led unit were significantly less likely to undergo obstetric interventions such as instrumental delivery, epidural analgesia, and episiotomy, without an increase in maternal or neonatal complications, compared to those in an Obstetric unit.
mod_finding: Women in the MLU were more likely to have a vaginal birth (91.4% vs 83.8%) and less likely to have an instrumental delivery (3.9% vs 11.2%) compared to women in the OU.
